units.source_text: 二女公子把薰大将所说的话悄悄地告诉中将君，

en.t: The Second Princess quietly told Chujo no Kimi what General Kaoru had said,

units.source_text: 对她说道：“这薰大将性情固执，

en.t: and said to her, "This General Kaoru is stubborn by nature,

units.source_text: 凡事一经决定，便不轻易变计。

en.t: once he has decided on something, he does not easily change his mind.

units.source_text: 不过目前他新招驸马，这情况的确有些不利。

en.t: But at present he has only recently been taken as a son-in-law, and that situation is indeed somewhat unfavorable.

units.source_text: 但你既然要让她出家，就算是当了尼姑，

en.t: But since you mean to have her take religious vows, even if she becomes a nun,
you should still try marrying her to him."

units.source_text: 中将君说：“我为欲使浮舟不遭苦患，不受人侮，

en.t: Chujo no Kimi said, "I wanted Ukifune to suffer no hardships and endure no contempt,

units.source_text: 所以打算叫她闭居在‘不闻飞鸟声’的深山中。

en.t: and so I meant to have her live shut away in deep mountains where even the cries of flying birds are not heard.

units.source_text: 但今天拜见了这位薰大将的容貌风采，连我这上了年纪的人也觉得若能依附在他身边，即使当奴仆也是福气。

en.t: But today, after seeing this General Kaoru's looks and bearing, even someone as old as I am feels it would be a blessing to be near him, even as a servant.

units.source_text: 何况青年女子，看见了他一定倾心爱慕。

en.t: How much more surely would a young woman, once she saw him, give him her whole heart and love him.

units.source_text: 然而我这女儿‘身既不足数’，会不会反而莳下了忧患的种子呢？

en.t: Yet my daughter is of such little account; might this not instead sow the seeds of sorrow?

units.source_text: 原来做女子的，不论身份贵贱，为了男女之事，往往不但今世吃苦，到后世也还要受累。

en.t: After all, for women, whether highborn or lowly, affairs between men and women often bring suffering not only in this life but even burdens in the life to come.

units.source_text: 如此想来，这孩子实在可怜得很！

en.t: Thinking of it this way, the child is truly pitiable.
Still, I ask you to decide everything.

units.source_text: 无论怎样，请您不要舍弃她！”

en.t: Whatever happens, please do not abandon her!"

units.source_text: 二女公子颇感为难，叹息说道：“怎么办呢？

en.t: The Second Princess felt deeply troubled and said with a sigh, "What should be done?

units.source_text: 就过去看来，这薰大将富有深情，很可信赖。

en.t: Judging from the past, this General Kaoru is deeply feeling and very trustworthy.

units.source_text: 但今后如何，难于预知了。”

en.t: But it is hard to know what will happen from now on."
Beyond that, she said little more.
